findings: Noise rate (0.88) is high: 17 of 25 findings are false or not applicable, indicating significant agent output noise despite passing other thresholds.
Final outcome improvement rate is 0.0; agent activity has not yet translated into measurable outcome improvements in the value-gate fixture.
Current human intervention rate (0.0833) exceeds the long-term target maximum (0.01) by over 8x, acknowledged in limitations but unresolved.
Pilot uses a single model lineage (qwen3.7-max) across seven sessions, limiting independence and generalizability of results.
Agent operational value and community self-maintenance remain undemonstrated (false in current-state.json).
No external participants, adopters, or contributors; pilot is entirely internal and synthetic.
Maintenance report identifies a source revision drift but proposes no automatic correction, requiring human follow-up.
required_corrections: Reduce agent noise rate substantially below 0.88 before claiming operational value; investigate root causes of 68% false/not-applicable findings.
Address the gap between current human intervention rate (0.0833) and long-term target (0.01) with a concrete reduction plan or revised target.
Resolve the source revision drift flagged in MAINT-PILOT-001 or formally accept the drift with documented rationale.
optional_suggestions: Introduce at least one additional independent model lineage to strengthen claims of model-agnostic agent behavior.
Define intermediate milestones for outcome improvement rate to track progress from the current 0.0 baseline.
Consider expanding the value-gate fixture to include tasks where agent suggestions can plausibly yield measurable outcome improvements.
uncertainty: Whether the 0.88 noise rate is inherent to the agent approach or an artifact of the specific fixture design and task selection.
Whether the single-model lineage limitation materially affects the validity of the passed thresholds.
Whether the frozen value-gate fixture is representative of real-world tasks where outcome improvement could be demonstrated.
limitations: Review is based solely on provided JSON artifacts; no independent execution or external validation was performed.
Pilot is internal, synthetic, and controlled; results do not imply readiness for external adoption, public launch, or certification.
Independence is LEVEL_2 (same model, isolated session); findings may not capture cross-model or cross-session failure modes.
No human decision-making or authorization is implied or granted by this review.
